action_inputs.description: The ordering group is always entitled to deploy into the namespace. Optionally entitle one more CloudBolt group.
action_inputs.label: Additional CloudBolt Group
action_inputs.name: gke_ns_additional_group

action_inputs.description: GKE cluster to create the namespace on, from the Kubernetes Cluster resources whose environment the ordering group can use.
action_inputs.label: GKE Cluster
action_inputs.name: gke_ns_cluster

action_inputs.description: Traffic the namespace's NetworkPolicies let out of its pods: to anywhere, to pods in the same namespace only, or none. DNS lookups are always allowed.
action_inputs.label: Egress Policy
action_inputs.name: gke_ns_egress_policy

action_inputs.description: Traffic the namespace's NetworkPolicies let into its pods: from pods in the same namespace (and kube-system) only, from anywhere, or none.
action_inputs.label: Ingress Policy
action_inputs.name: gke_ns_ingress_policy

action_inputs.description: Namespace name: 1-63 lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens. Names starting with kube-, gke-, or gmp- and the namespaces Kubernetes and GKE reserve are not allowed.
action_inputs.label: Namespace Name
action_inputs.name: gke_ns_namespace_name

action_inputs.description: Sets the namespace ResourceQuota (CPU, memory, storage, volume claims, and pods) and the matching CloudBolt environment quota.
action_inputs.label: Size Tier
action_inputs.name: gke_ns_size_tier

action_inputs.description: Kubernetes role the team principals get in the namespace: Edit, View, or Admin.
action_inputs.label: Team Access Level
action_inputs.name: gke_ns_team_access_level

action_inputs.description: Google accounts, Google Groups, or Google service accounts, one per line, to give kubectl access to this namespace through Kubernetes RBAC: user:EMAIL, group:EMAIL (needs Google Groups for RBAC on the cluster), or serviceAccount:EMAIL. Leave empty to grant access later with Manage GKE Namespace Access.
action_inputs.label: Team Google Principals
action_inputs.name: gke_ns_team_principals

description: Creates a namespace with a tiered ResourceQuota, default container limits, and the chosen ingress and egress NetworkPolicies on an existing GKE cluster, then pins a CloudBolt environment to it, entitles the ordering group, and grants Google principals namespace-scoped Kubernetes RBAC access.
name: GKE Namespace
